hero_lede: One breeder. Every cross selected, grown and documented like a work in progress.
manifesto: Most genetics are made to be common. Ours are made to be remembered. Each line begins as a quiet idea, a colour, a scent, a mood, and is painted into being over many seasons by one pair of hands.
lines_intro: Five lines, each bred slowly and released in limited seed runs.

process.title: Select
process.text: Hundreds of seedlings are grown out and judged on structure, aroma and vigour. Only a handful earn a second look.

process.title: Cross
process.text: Chosen parents are paired with intent. Every pairing is recorded, from the first pollen to the last seed.

process.title: Cultivate
process.text: Plants are grown by hand under steady conditions, so what we see in a line is genuinely the genetics speaking.

process.title: Document
process.text: Each season is photographed, measured and written up, so every line has a story and a trail of evidence.

disclaimer: For adults 21+, and only where legal. Please check your local laws.
